$comment: Perf check config. See docs/perf.md. Regression = PR worse than main by more than BOTH pct and abs. deterministic: fail above failPct. noisy: warn above warnPct, fail above failPct (never fails where noisyFail is false, per platform or per metric via platforms.<os>.noisyFail); when only noisy metrics fail, CI benches again and judges the pooled runs. leak: fail when PR leaves anything behind and more than main.

phases.title: Cold start by phase (warn-only)
phases.note: Each row is ms from process start to that point (best of the runs; the bench's own profile seeding is cut out). Main-process marks come from `traceStartup()` in src/main/startup-defer.ts, the toolbar from its `surffish:first-commit` mark (it sits hidden behind the New Tab page, so it has no paint of its own); a build without them shows –. Warm start = a start-up-only launch on the profile the warm-up left behind (V8 code cache, HTTP cache, window state already there).

bundle.appPayload.label: packaged app payload (app.asar contents)
bundle.appPayload.$comment: build.files + production node_modules closure minus build.files exclusions (scripts/perf/app-payload.ts)

startup.firstPaintMs.label: cold start to first paint
startup.firstPaintMs.$comment: best of the runs: a busy pod stalls single cold starts by 0.5-3 s on identical code

startup.mainImportMs.label: main process JS load (import of out/main/index.js)

memMax.gpuMB.label: GPU process memory, 30 tabs
memMax.gpuMB.$comment: warn-only on linux: SwiftShader's GPU process sits at ~57-61 MB or ~92-103 MB on identical code (bimodal, Oct 2026 CI), so +30-40% swings flipped the check. The Mac job is where GPU memory means something.

openTabs.ipcCount.label: IPC messages opening 20 tabs
openTabs.ipcCount.$comment: timing-dependent, so noisy (gets the confirmation pass): tab/state broadcasts are coalesced per frame, 115-151 on identical code (Oct 2026 CI)

openTabs.ipcBytes.label: IPC payload opening 20 tabs
openTabs.ipcBytes.$comment: timing-dependent like ipcCount: 59-76 KB on identical code (Oct 2026 CI), so noisy (gets the confirmation pass)

tabSwitch.medianMs.label: tab switch to painted
tabSwitch.medianMs.$comment: software-rendered pods: per-run medians range ~23-40 ms on identical code

startup.renderer.toolbarCommitMs.label: toolbar JS start-up inside its renderer (navigation → first commit)

startup.phases.extensionsReadyMs.label: deferred: extensions ready, page requests released

warm.startup.firstPaintMs.label: warm start: first paint (New Tab page)

sites.renderers.label: renderers hosting 16 tabs over 4 sites
sites.renderers.$comment: pages + iframes of the site tabs; same-site tabs share one process unless Settings turns it off (--process-per-site)

adblock.frameStartBytes.label: ad-filter CSS + scriptlets sent per navigation
adblock.frameStartBytes.$comment: bench fixture: video.localhost, 18 scriptlets sharing helpers + site and generic CSS

adblock.frameStartMainMs.label: ad-filter frame-start main time per navigation
